# NoteGuess

> NoteGuess is a free browser-based Guess the Song Game at https://guesssong.me/.

## What it does

- Players hear five short synthesized arrangements and select song titles.
- The current melody references are public-domain works; no commercial recordings are streamed.
- Scores and daily streaks are stored locally in the player's browser.

## Important pages

- [Play Guess the Song Game](https://guesssong.me/): daily game, FAQ, sources, and structured data.
- [About NoteGuess](https://guesssong.me/about): product scope, creator, and implementation summary.
- [Source notes](https://guesssong.me/#sources): cited public-domain melody references.
- [Privacy Policy](https://guesssong.me/privacy): local storage and data handling.
- [Terms of Use](https://guesssong.me/terms): conditions for using the game.
- [Contact](https://guesssong.me/contact): GitHub issue tracker for feedback.
